note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Castlederg rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There were no contests: with one exception every retiring member was returned unopposed. The new council had ten Unionists and six Nationalists. Longfield is recorded from the Ulster Herald, 28 May 1949, p. 3. The other fourteen retiring members are not named in any 1949 report read; the Council had changed since 1946 (the 1946 return gave Unionists three Nationalist seats, but the 1949 council had ten Unionists and six Nationalists), so they are not inferred from the 1946 return. Replaced Mr. John Verner, Jnr. (U.) in the Killen district. Returned unopposed.
